title: Service Customer, the export's last column, names the customer the work was for
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with its own IBS account number.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today, billed to customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, invoiced today, that bills itself.
  • Start on the page that exports the invoice list.
custom_steps:
1. Export the invoice list to CSV.
  2. Open the CSV file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A CSV file downloads.

Step 2:

  • The last column is "Service Customer".
  • Work order 1's invoice row reads customer B's name under Customer and customer A's name under Service Customer.
  • Work order 2's invoice row is blank under Service Customer.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12321 (Story 19, IBS, invoice export and Public API)

  • S19-R6: “The export's last column, "Service Customer", names the customer the work was for when someone else is billed.”
  • S19-N1: “"Service Customer" is blank when the invoice bills its own customer.”
  • Feature Overview, Release day: “The invoice CSV export gains a last column, "Service Customer", blank on every invoice billed to its own customer (Story 19).”
